column3: in the form of the six lordly powers
endowed with the six lordly powers
sixth skandha, in the story of Ajamila
sixteen thousand, with the arrows of Love
sixteen thousand, by arrows of Love whose sense...
with doubts about duality cut off
of one who has renounced all action
medicine for the disease of worldly life
free of attachment to worldly life
when the great chariot-warrior had died
meeting each other, the splendours of both
with Girija (Parvati), he gave his own weapon
Sati's giving up of the body
in wombs of mixed good and bad
ever young in the beauty of limbs
by good thoughts and so on
cuts off at once, for the Unblinking
one who has attained samadhi-yoga along with the manifold universe
with a pair of lotus-bud eyes closed in samadhi yoga
took the honey-prideful women's equal... (took away equally)
pure water of lakes with pairs of various birds
subduing the ocean and so on
of the two who are looking on
you cannot grasp, O one of immature mind
with highways, streets, markets and crossings well swept
bearer of the powers of all agencies
at the end of all qualities (the result)
attended by all the groups of gods
situated inside and outside all beings
with hermitages, creepers and holy trees of all seasons and all wealth
like children to the friend and protector of all
fit to be served by all
of one full of all wonders
the selfhood of all the senses
blazing with crowds of crowded spirits
the principle of one's own birth
with a thousand heads, ears, eyes and noses
in the best of the Satvatas
the good woman by the wicked
as if worshipping with his younger brother
and at evening, step by step
adorned with white parasol and fans
sprinkled with tears from the eyes
by hearing your auspicious qualities and so on
with the wish to do the gods' work
like a wishing-tree of the gods
the ocean of gods and demons
of the infant at the breast
by women, shudras and others too
world of beings turned to bathing and sex
in the fall of the rays of affection
by pride, company and intoxications of yours
remembering the embrace of Mukunda's feet
roll about for the one remembering
captivated by glimpses of smiling glances
... by the skilled in love's mantras sent from the circle of brows
when he went to his own abode
like the best of the immortals
by service the waters of the heavenly river
putting heaven's glory in the shade
his own dwelling, the lotus forest
revealing the secret of own Self
study of the Veda, austerity, renunciation
of one's own people wishing for water
own experience, the essence of all the Vedas
of the one made by own will
You, whose movements are known only at will
freely by the Lord's own maya
one who serves the company of the good
